Its `save` adds the attribute to the parent visit, or calls `setAttribute` when the type has max occurs of 1, then calls `Context.getVisitService().saveVisit(visit)` (@file:{openmrs-module-webservices.rest::omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/VisitAttributeResource1_9.java:97-116}).

**4. Data access:** `HibernateVisitDAO.saveVisit` is `@Transactional` and calls `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate(getCurrentSession(), visit)` (@file:{openmrs-core::api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateVisitDAO.java:165-169}). The attribute row is written through the visit's attribute collection rather than by a separate attribute insert.
